findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 列示主要對手（Honeywell、Siemens、Schneider、Carrier、Trane、Vertiv、API Group、Daikin），並指出數位服務、SaaS、IoT 領域有新創與新進入者競爭；稱失去任一合約或客戶不會有重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: Larger competitors include Honeywell International, Inc.; Siemens Smart Infrastructure, an operating group of Siemens AG; Schneider Electric SA; Carrier Global Corporation; Trane Technologies plc; Vertiv Holdings Co., API Group and Daikin Industries, Ltd.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子指出 AI 技術快速演進，若未跟上，競爭地位與經營結果可能受損。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: If we fail to keep pace with rapidly evolving technological developments in AI, our competitive position and business results may suffer.
